subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should this current rebase and its boundary-hardening commit become the canonical landing path for OpenAI-compatible `xhigh` reasoning effort support, replacing the older overlapping PR?
rationale: Both open branches materially overlap, while this branch changes compatibility-sensitive provider request behavior and is behind the present main head; selecting one canonical branch and accepting the resulting durable contract requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt this rebase as canonical
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, rerun its focused request-capture proof and required checks, then close the older overlapping PR as superseded.

options.title: Continue the older PR instead
options.body: Transfer the focused hardening commit and current-head proof to the older branch, then close this rebase to retain the original contribution path.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Pause the implementation until maintainers clarify whether provider-specific reasoning-effort mapping belongs in the durable compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebase as canonical
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, rerun its focused request-capture proof and required checks, then close the older overlapping PR as superseded.
